card_name: Axis Bank My Wings Credit Card
fee_details:
* Joining Fee: Rs.2,200
* Annual Fee: 1st Year: Nil; 2nd Year onwards: Rs.2,500
* Add-on Card Issuing Fee: Nil
* Add-on Card Renewal Fee: Nil
* Card Replacement Fee (lost or stolen or re-issued): Waived off
* Cash Payment Fee: Rs.100
* Duplicate Statement Fee: Waived off
* Charges if received for copy request/ Copy Fee: Waived off
* Outstation Cheque Fee: Waived off
* Mobile Alerts for Transactions: Free
* Charges for Hotlisting: Nil
* Balance Enquiry Charges: Waived off
* Finance Charges: 2.99% p.m.
* Fees for Cash Withdrawal: 2.5% of the cash amount subject to minimum Rs.500
* Over Limit Penalty/ Late Payment Fee:
    * Nil if total payment Due is upto Rs.2,000
    * Rs.500 if total payment due is between Rs.2,101 - Rs.5,000
    * Rs.1000 if total payment due is between Rs.5,101 - Rs.15000
    * Rs.1500 if total payment due is between Rs.15001 - Rs.20000
    * Rs.2000 if total payment due is between Rs.20001 - Rs.25000
    * Rs.2500 if total payment due is Rs.25001 and above
* Over Limit Penalty: 3% of the overdue amount subject to minimum Rs.500
* Cheque return or dishonour/Auto Debit reversal: Rs.300
* Surcharge on purchase/cancellation of railway tickets: Applicable as per IRCTC or Indian Railways
* Fuel Transaction Surcharge Transaction: 1% of the transaction amount. Transaction made should be between Rs.400 and Rs.4,000
* Foreign Currency Transaction Fee: 3.5% of the transaction value
* Reward Point Redemption Fee: Nil
* GST: As per prevailing norms
joining_perks: Complimentary flight tickets, Access to airport lounges, Cashback offers, Hotel and Holiday vouchers
reward_structure: 2 Complimentary Flight tickets, Family vacations (four flight tickets bookings), Hotels & Holiday Vouchers, Four online rail ticket bookings, Two bus ticket bookings, One Car rental bookings, Fuel Surcharge Waiver, Other Spends, Complimentary airport lounge access
key_highlights: * You can apply for Axis Bank My Wings Credit Card and you can request transfers as you allow two complimentary flight tickets at one booking. You also get other benefits such as access to airport lounge cashback at an IRCTC, railway tickets, bus tickets, and domestic flight tickets.

benefits_features.Travel benefits:
Redeem your complimentary flight tickets easily. You can redeem your complimentary flight tickets easily by following these simple steps:
Give a call on the Exotel helpline number 18001200488 and request for the order or alternatively providing your 15-digits Axis Bank My Wings Credit Card number.
benefits_features.Dining benefits: Dining Delight: Get a 15% off on your bill on dining at any restaurant in partnership with Axis bank which accepts the Axis Bank My Wings Credit Card.

how_tos.How to Apply: You can apply for this credit card by either getting in touch with an Axis Bank representative who will help you with the application process. You can also visit the nearest Axis Bank branch along with all the relevant documents. A representative from the bank will help you with the process of applying for this particular credit card.
